summary: Comprehensive competitive analysis decomposing Credence's copy mechanics (The Gap positioning, systems language, quiet confidence tone, tiered pipeline architecture, scarcity model) and Opus Athletic's visual system (monochrome palette, chiaroscuro photography, blueprint text posts, editorial restraint). Synthesizes both into a proposed brand blueprint for Farrice including: core positioning ('The Articulation Gap'), 3 color palette options, typography stack, 2-system service architecture, tiered pipeline model, scarcity framing, and competitive advantages over Credence.
